summary: REQ-1007 asks for SignalWatch Advanced (Observability, $24,000/yr, 25 users) for Engineering with production_telemetry access and a Production cloud account integration. Budget fits (available $26,000 vs $24,000 requested). However, Engineering already holds approved SignalWatch (SW005, 80 seats, Engineering scope), vendor evidence conflicts (registry says security Approved, live risk tool says review expired), and evaluate_policy requires Security review. Evidence only; no approval is implied. No instruction-like text was found in the request.
concerns: Conflicting vendor evidence: lookup_vendor_registry shows security_status Approved (review date 2025-07-01) but get_vendor_risk shows security_review_status expired with last_review_date 2025-07-01; the registry notes say it has not yet been refreshed with latest review state. The favourable registry status cannot be relied on.
get_vendor_risk notes: 'Reassessment required before expanded production access.' The request asks for production_telemetry access and a Production cloud account integration.

Existing tool overlap: find_existing_software returns SW005 SignalWatch (Approved, 80 licensed seats, scope Engineering, covers requester department) matching same_vendor, same_product and same_category; PO-2418 shows $80,000 annual renewal on 2026-03-01 for the same vendor.
The business justification ('Advanced incident analytics for production services.') does not state which capability the existing SignalWatch licence lacks.

Budget is tight: Engineering committed_usd 274000 of 300000, available_usd 26000; this request of 24000 is within budget (within_budget true) but would leave little headroom. Budget determination is deferred to evaluate_policy.

evaluate_policy lists required approvals: Department Head, Finance, Procurement, Security; risk flags: existing_tool_overlap, conflicting_vendor_evidence, vendor_review_expired, security_review_required; baseline label 'Escalate to Security for manual review'.

overlap_assessment.reason: The same vendor's approved SignalWatch product (SW005, 80 seats, Engineering scope, covers the requester's department) is in the same Observability category. The request does not identify a specific capability the existing licence lacks, so no credible gap is evidenced; whether the Advanced tier adds needed functionality is not verified by any tool result. This is a same-vendor overlap, not a different vendor's tool.
